data.summary: Reviews show a mixed but authentic picture. The company has been in business for 51 years and has many positive reviews citing knowledgeable, helpful staff (Logan, Rick). However, there are consistent complaints about communication, responsiveness, and delays in service/repairs, particularly reflected in the lower Yelp rating. The BBB A+ rating with no visible complaints suggests they handle formal disputes adequately. The negative reviews contain specific, credible details.
fake_signals: Limited sample of Google reviews provided (8 total, strategic selection)
Some 5-star reviews are very brief and generic (e.g., 'prices are great')

negative_evidence: Complaint about failure to inform of equipment issues leading to costly repairs
Long delay (3+ months) on a paid robot repair with poor communication
positive_evidence: Positive experience handling a Polaris warranty inquiry over the phone

authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Logan S, Rick, Braxton)
Detailed project descriptions (resurfacing, automation, warranty troubleshooting)
Varied writing styles and specific complaints with dates/timelines
Mix of praise for individuals and criticism of processes

reviews.text: This is in response to the lack of attention Braxton one of ur pool cleaners has again failed to inform me of our actuators going out! Now 836 dollars later I’ve not only paid for a new Polaris, then a new pump, and all could have been told to me regarding Polaris and actuators! I would like to request someone else to clean my pool from this point on!
reviews.author: Mary Lenz

reviews.text: A-Quality did a great job handling my Polaris warranty inquiry, troubleshooting my Polaris low pressure issue and helping me isolate the problem to my booster supply pump for resolution. Took no more than 5 minutes over the phone. I’ve since scheduled the pool equipment repair service. Their customer service and support between their retail and pool service reps helped save me time and money chasing a Polaris solution unnecessarily. Thank y'all so much.
reviews.author: Tom Sisoian

reviews.text:
My experience with A-Quality pools has been anything but good. The sales person was very friendly but that is where it stopped.
The spa I purchased was in stock but yet could not be delivered for over a week because the installer was out of the office. You only have one person doing installs? Also told we can't deliver until we do a site inspection. It took them a week to come and do the site inspection, same guy is out of the office.
The spa is finally delivered. The front panel is cracked, the front latch is bent and broken, the back panel is damaged from the trailer they brought it on and two of the LED light housings are broken and I can't fill the tub!! Three weeks later I still don't have a functioning hot tub!! I have called no less that six times with zero results!!! lies on top of lies is all I get. They will not even tell me if the parts have been ordered or if they have when do they arrive. How long do I have to wait???
Run away, fast. These people will take your money and leave you hanging.
reviews.author: Scott Romine

reviews.text: AQuality Pools took their time to figure out what was wrong with my pool equipment after another company had said extra stuff needed replaced when it didn’t and saved me a lot of money.
reviews.author: Andrew Andersen

reviews.text: In working with Logan S I want to tell everyone this is the company to use. I’ve had my pool resurfaced, all electronics completely automated,  extremely knowledgeable Logan S will not let you down. THANK  YOU.
reviews.author: Brian Carpenter

reviews.text: I'm not sure what has happened to this place but it's definitely gone downhill. I dropped off my robot to be repaired Dec. 5th. I was told there were 8 others in front of mine and they should have it diagnosed by the end of the month. I paid the $75 fee and leave it there. I try to call mid Jan and no one answers, I leave a message, nothing, finally I stop by the store and I'm told they are just really backed up. Fast forward to now March, I call a few times to get an update and still no answer, I leave messages, and yet again, no one calls back.  Finally I stop by again to check on it. Once someone finally steps out from the back to help me, I'm told it's still waiting to be diagnosed. They've had my pool cleaner for 3 months and never even looked at it. I guess they can only work one at a time, what happened to " we will know something by the end of Dec ?". I will say that when I asked for my equipment back and a refund on the diagnostic fee they did not hesitate. By the frustration I could see on the employee's face, I could tell I'm not the only person bothered by their practices of late. Now I'm on the hunt for a new pool supply and repair store.
reviews.author: Jayson Mathewson

reviews.text:
I want to give a 10 star review for Rick.
He went above and beyond the line of duty helping me today.
He is professional, kind, caring and knows his business. Rick’s Follow up skills are awesome. Rick contacted me after I got home to make sure everything was ok.
If your looking for a good pool company with outstanding customer service and quality products, please give A Quality a try, you won’t use anyone else!
Thank you Rick!!
reviews.author: Deanne Harvey
